scope: Post-run result audit of the frozen primary and selected saved queries; no new inference, primary rerun, source edit or test execution.
reviewer_role: Core implementation owner reviewing frozen results; separate pre-run algebra/source review is design_review.json.

functional.comment: Recorded warm checkpoints and queries agree exactly; cold reset clears belief while preserving index/time; no operational failures. Zero gain still advances known physical state and chronology.

resource.comment: Constant-size host objects and no raw history; budget excludes complete stack, libm/libc/FILE, acquisition, interrupts and target runtime. Serialized checkpoint size is not a second simultaneous RAM buffer.

numerical.comment: No sampled nonfinite/model-recovery failure; this supports tested arithmetic/lifecycle correctness, not indefinite availability or numerical convergence to the correct nonlinear belief.

gate_conclusions.promotion: Do not promote this candidate to the variation/year campaign or call it M23-qualified.

measured_failures.source_cause: correct() chooses the minimum support-admissible scale over all 16 coordinates. An outward correction at one nuisance bound sets common lambda to zero and blocks SOC/Q observation correction as well. Source and selected queries agree; this is the declared policy, not a physical sample-order failure.
measured_failures.limit: Bounds and zero-gain counters are observed at saved queries; no claim that every intervening limiting coordinate was identified.

measured_failures.interpretation: The local Gaussian width screen can be precise around a biased capacity point. Provisional labels and local_precision_hard flags do not certify hard accuracy or coverage; even near-unit innovation EWMA does not validate capacity uncertainty.

cold_counter_correction.comment: Counters survive reset. Subtract A 6069 and B 29965 at reset from final counters; using cumulative counts would overstate post-reset stalls.

measured_failures.limit: Removing common-gain stall alone is not established as sufficient: A cold remains biased with only 3.41% post-reset zero-gain updates.

belief_vector_scope: The16-coordinate scored RMS is an engineering-scale point-error summary, not a percent or posterior distance. This learner tracks current z/v/h, unlike the retained-history entering-state parameter vector. Full parameter truth accuracy is not implied by acceptable SOC point error.
lifetime_scope: The primary contains two 2100-second trajectories with duplicated warm/cold delivery paths, not an annual or indefinite experiment. Fixed storage, PSD square-factor algebra and finite-value/counter guards do not prove all-prefix accuracy, coverage, availability or floating-point stability.

one_next_bounded_change.proposal: Replace the single common support-limited gain with a boundary-aware active-set gain that can retain admissible SOC/Q updates when one nuisance correction points outward.
one_next_bounded_change.constraints: Use the same chosen gain for mean and a valid Joseph square-root covariance update; preserve full cross-correlations, fixed memory, chronology and once-only observation handling. Hold data, public prior, model and acceptance gates fixed in a separately frozen short follow-up.
one_next_bounded_change.falsification: Check whether the measured Cell B stall decreases and scheduled hard accuracy improves, while retaining the existing provisional hard-error audit. Do not claim success from fewer zero gains alone.
one_next_bounded_change.remaining_blocker: Wrong narrow capacity beliefs remain an independent rejection reason; no uncertainty or target guarantee is established by this proposed change.
